title: Apartment 74, Hybreasal House, Kilmainham, Dublin 8
description: It's the MAGIC APARTMENT again!  from 01 OCTOBER 2026 as current tenants return to US. A spacious, elegant, modern, cozy, charming ground floor apartment, 2 beds (one double, one single (converts to double w trundle)) with generous shower/ bathroom in stately Kilmainham, right next to St James' and the new Childrens' Hospital. Under the leafy trees of the SCR in sylvan, manicured grounds this ground level home is tucked into romantic and imposing Hybreasal House, a castellated former 19th C infirmary - right at the heart of Dublin City’s most dramatic historic quarter - that enjoys national artistic, historic, social and architectural heritage importance  (NIAH reg 50080107) Structure and interiors recently upgraded with fine conservation finishes and exemplary fire, accessibility, energy and security enhancements.  Minutes from Suir Rd & RIalto Luas, well-serviced by bus routes (stop at front gate), Dublin Bikes right outside. Can include secure enclosed car space (€150, currentl let) in brightly lit, overlooked cobbled park beside the legendary secret garden. All mod cons, electric heating, ample storage, fully furnished with all equipment & fittings. A fascinating origin story: named for the mystical island off the west coast of ireland illustrated in ancient Ptolemy 4th C Europe maps. You will be part of a secluded, integrated community among exquisite lawns, walks and nooks for private relaxation and recreation. Gated campus has strict access control, excellent surveillance, on a regular garda beat. This peaceful pod enjoys more  ample living than most houses, featuring full-height period casement windows on 3 sides, drenched in daylight all day long with great spatial quality.  Double bedroom, is tidy and specious, one intimate bed-room with pull-out trundle, ideal for singleton or parent/child. Living/Dining includes huge Corner Sofa w pull-out bed.  Recently refurbished kitchen fully equipped, ventilated bathroom and shower with slate rubber floor. All interiors regularly refreshed.  references will be key consideration- the place is precious and  has been a truly transformative residence  - former occupants claim unexpected and miraculous experiences here! :pivotal, positive, impossible and improbable life changes have started here! Be warned! It really is the MAGIC apartment! Looking for respectful responsible tenants with own means or family who'll appreciate the special environment and make this place their home. No more than three tenants or four with two sharing. flexible, kind and uncomplicated landlords. Available from October 2026. Can’t wait to  meet you x
